points.text: Theorem assumes exact marginals; learned scores, schedules, discretisation and resampling not covered
Molecular data mixed continuous/categorical, so guarantee doesn't cover experiment
Converse only for strictly negative C_k; C_k=0 and diverging sums unaddressed
'Predicts exactly' only for compact support; unbounded support not covered
Near-zero C_k yields huge variance, the regime where large B degrades
Bump adds B-proportional FK weight term causing SMC degeneracy
No ESS traces, resampling stats, particle study or runtime/NFE comparison
B selected by performance; 'B=30 works' rests only on synthetic study
Choice of expert receiving bump and bump shape not ablated
Few pockets and molecules; counts and subset selection not in main text
Molecular tables lack confidence intervals or seeds
NR and FKC at w=1.0 should coincide but differ; FKC non-monotone
Predicted collapse for w>1.1 not visible; 'catastrophic collapse' rests on noisy numbers
ACE reported at best w selected on benchmark while baselines fixed
Different conditioning and training data; Vina a weak proxy
No diversity, novelty, validity, SA/QED metrics in main text
Only NR and FKC; no schedule reparameterisation or guidance clipping baselines
Synthetic task constructed to exhibit failure, so gain is expected
'Provably guarantees' and 'complete solution' overstated given theory gaps
'Fundamental failure mode', general paradigm and COCO-MIG claims unsupported
Novelty relative to CFG schedulers needs more discussion
Proofs, setup, metrics, hyperparameters and counts deferred to long appendix
Table 2 has odd variance entries and questionable validity marks
Typos such as 'cooridnate'
Figures 1-4 central but qualitative
Origin of ratio-of-densities from CFG/contrastive decoding unclear; experts undefined
Feynman-Kac Correctors lack explicit mathematical formulation
Significance of Marginal Path Collapse not convincing
Key experimental setup aspects unclear or unreasonable
Nonstandard conditional independence notation and extra periods
Evidence the phenomenon occurs in practice weak; frequency not measured
Synthetic setup designed to trigger collapse; not a realistic testbed
Unclear whether molecular gains stem from tuning or actual collapse
Little explanation of which tasks fit framework; need mathematical derivations of use cases
Missing references, incomplete proofs, contradictions and undefined symbols in appendix
Several typos around lines 239, 263 and Section 3.1
Derivations heavy; Theorem 2.3 unclear; ACE pseudocode would help
No clear guidance on choosing bump coefficient B
